TS007 no-dynamic-exec

Code is not built and run at runtime, because nothing can be checked before it executes.

languages: javascript python typescript
severity: error
default: on
group: stable
go: Go has no eval or exec; there is no runtime string-to-code path to report
odin: Odin has no eval or exec; there is no runtime string-to-code path to report
rust: Rust has no eval or exec; there is no runtime string-to-code path to report
zig: Zig has no eval or exec; there is no runtime string-to-code path to report

NASA P10 Rule 10: "All code must be checked daily with at least one, but preferably more than one, state-of-the-art static source code analyzer and should pass the analyses with zero warnings."
